title: Scorers in Europa League finals
brief: Name any player who scored in a UEFA Cup or Europa League final from 2001 to 2026. Own goals and penalty shoot-outs don't count.
period: UEFA Cup and Europa League finals 2001 to 2026 (one-match finals; the last two-legged final was 1997)

notes.Delfi Geli: Delfi Geli's golden goal in 2001 was an own goal for Liverpool, so he doesn't count.
notes.Gianluca Mancini: Gianluca Mancini's goal in the 2023 final was an own goal for Sevilla, so he doesn't count.
notes.Ivan Rakitic: Ivan Rakitic captained Sevilla to the 2014 title, but that final was 0-0 and won on penalties.
notes.Ollie Watkins: Ollie Watkins didn't score in the 2026 final; Tielemans, Buendia and Rogers scored in Villa's 3-0 win.
notes.Marcus Rashford: Marcus Rashford didn't score in a final; United lost 2021 on penalties and 2025 1-0.
notes.Romelu Lukaku: Romelu Lukaku counts: he scored a penalty for Inter in 2020 (and an own goal later in the game).
notes.Alan Shearer: Alan Shearer never played in a final in this period.
notes.Adriano: This is Adriano Correia, who scored for Sevilla in the 2007 final.
notes.Diego: This is Diego Ribas, who scored for Atletico Madrid in the 2012 final.

sources: https://match.uefa.com/v5/matches?competitionId=14 (UEFA.com match data for each final, scorers and goal types)
checks: Every final's scorers from UEFA.com's match data match the Wikipedia article for that final (all 26 finals, scorers, minutes and own goals). Own goals (Geli 2001, Lukaku 2020, Mancini 2023) are left out; Lukaku still counts for his penalty. The 2014 final was 0-0. 66 players in all.
